title: Pricol plunges 20% on Warburg stake deal

timeline.title: Pricol plunges 20% on Warburg stake deal
timeline.line: Warburg will buy promoters' 38.51% of demerged Pricol Autotech for up to ₹1,663 crore
more: The stake is in the demerged unit, not in Pricol Ltd itself
Warburg will also make an open offer for up to 26% more of Pricol Autotech
The deal depends on the demerger, listing and regulatory approvals

src.title: Pricol shares plunge 20% at market open; Warburg Pincus deal puts demerged business in focus
